verdict: Poor platform fit (single-process SQLite fleet monitor with no site/rack model, node lifecycle, plugins, audit or MCP), but its staged telemetry-gated rollout, two-phase enrollment and ACK-after-commit edge journal are worth re-implementing on Temporal.

patterns.pattern: Withheld vs failed: typed eligibility refusals that don't consume blast-radius budget
At-least-once edge telemetry: stream id + durable seq + declared gaps + ACK after commit
Accepted / confirmed / unknown tri-state action outcomes
Health evidence bound to the current connection and receiver clock
Staged canary rollout with durable slots and telemetry dwell gate
Two-phase enrollment: issue, stage, commit, confirm
Signed artifacts with persistent anti-rollback floor on the node
Outbound-only agent channel with single-owner connection registry
Typed allowlisted node actions with fixed argv, no shell
Pinned-SPKI one-line bootstrap, non-consuming GET, uniform 404
Unprivileged control plane + root host worker via file inbox/outbox
Shared data-minimising contract package re-sanitised on both sides
Single-process SQLite hub with coordination state in globals
Free-text machine status with no lifecycle state machine
Hardware inventory as wholesale-overwritten JSON blob
String-switch integrations and hard-coded UI actions
